result.title: Selective Event Evidence and Persistent Temporal Priors for Event-Based Point Tracking
result.summary: Event cameras enable tracking under fast motion and challenging illumination. However, stable long-term point tracking remains challenging: event activity is sparse and varies with scene content and motion, complicating correspondence, while trajectory estimates can drift over long sequences. Together, these challenges motivate a tracker that selectively uses informative event evidence and retains trajectory constraints across temporal windows. We propose Selective Event Evidence and Persistent Temporal Priors (SEPT), an event-only framework for tracking any point (TAP) over long sequences. SEPT introduces two complementary modules: Task-Adaptive Event Evidence Modulation (TEEM) and Persistent Trajectory Prior (PTP). Using only tracking supervision, TEEM learns a bounded reliability field that weights the event tensor across space, time, and channels before feature extraction. PTP carries geometric information across overlapping windows by marginalizing a fixed local quadratic trajectory model with a Schur complement. Its visibility-aware correction refines overlap coordinates, while a clipped terminal velocity initializes coordinates at newly exposed timestamps. SEPT builds on the ETAP architecture. SEPT is trained exclusively on synthetic EventKubric data and evaluated on five datasets across TAP and feature tracking. Results show that SEPT outperforms the retrained ETAP baseline in average Jaccard for TAP and in feature age and expected feature age for feature tracking; it also surpasses several methods combining event and frame inputs on EC and EDS. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/sssxxxkkkk/SEPT.

AI.brief_summary: 提出仅用事件数据的长序列任意点跟踪框架 SEPT：任务自适应事件证据调制学习有界可靠度场，在空间、时间与通道上加权事件张量；持久轨迹先验以 Schur 补边缘化局部二次轨迹模型，跨重叠窗口传递几何约束。
AI.relevance_reason: 其证据可靠度门控与跨窗口状态传递机制，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选与 latent 状态延续提供方法线索，但需核查该几何设定能否迁移到 VLM 推理场景。
